name: Dúdar (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Dúdar (a bridge, trees and a river, with a scroll reading AYUNTAMIENTO DE DÚDAR).
history: Municipal flag of Dúdar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Dúdar arms — bridge, trees and river, with scroll
